answer: Sybil defense starts at a narrow admission jetty: each new identity burns a deposit and must produce graded work for three epochs before it can vote. Entry into the shared garden then requires a velvet rope from a sponsor already in the prior set, who locks matching stake that is slashed if the recruit's later grades look coordinated. An attacker therefore pays deposit, delay, and slashable collateral per fake, so herd size scales the cost linearly.
